args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN (banker's rounding) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP despite the docstring and FIN-212
spec requiring banker's rounding, causing nightly test failures in
tests/test_money.py. Also note the callsite pads correctly: use
rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN with a properly-quantized context is not needed
here; simply switching the rounding mode passes the tests.

args.head: fix/FIN-212-bankers-rounding
args.body:
Fixes the nightly build failure in tests/test_money.py.

**Problem:** `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (per FIN-212) but implemented `ROUND_HALF_UP`, so the test expecting `round_money(Decimal("2.665")) == Decimal("2.66")` failed (it produced `2.67`).

**Fix:** Switch the `quantize` call to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the docstring and FIN-212.

**Verification:** CI run `ci-0001` on this branch passed.
args.title: Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212
